title: How a game earns its place here
body: Game support at OpenPak is earned, not promised. A title starts as research: we document what its servers must say, with a source for every claim. Then a test rig proves the important paths, and a title gets called live only once people have played it online. On the Titles page every game carries a status: live, beta, alpha or requestable, and the compatibility grid fills in from real playtime. Each live game has its own channel here and a post in this one when it arrives. We update the pages as each title moves.
